title: Design: A 31-character term name fits on one row
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • Scenario: Your shop has a term of its own with the longest name allowed, and you compare its row with the design.
  • You are an Admin user working at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • The shop has its own active term {Term-A} whose name is 31 characters long, due 45 days after the invoice date.
    For example: {Term-A} is ZZAUTOTEST D-05 Net45 Fleet Acc (31 characters, as long as the design's Net 45 Fleet Accounts Payable X).
  • The browser window is 1440 px wide, at 100% zoom.
    For example: a maximised window on a 1440 x 900 screen.
  • The design picture ct-p1-12-a-31-character-term-name.png is attached to this case; open it at 100% zoom beside the screen.
  • Starting screen: the Settings page.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. In the Settings menu, click "Credit Terms".
  2. Resize the browser window to 1536 px wide (for example, maximise it on a 1536 x 864 screen at 100% zoom).
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: in the {Term-A} row, {Term-A} reads in full on one line, nothing cut off and no dots at the end, in its place among the 45-day terms (as in ct-p1-12-a-31-character-term-name.png).
  • Step 2: at 1536 px nothing overlaps, nothing is cut off and nothing needs a sideways scroll; the layout described above is unchanged, only wider.

A narrower window than 1440 px may wrap the name onto a second line; it must never be cut off (the design draws only 1440 px).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11670 (Story 1, Credit Terms page and list), story SV-11672 (Story 3, Create or edit a credit term)

  • S1-R15: “Term names are never cut off in the table; a long name wraps onto a second line, with its icons and "Default" tag after it.”
  • S3-R2, Name: “Name (required), focused on open, accepting at most 31 characters, with the hint "Up to 31 characters. Prints on invoices and goes to QuickBooks."”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Default Credit Terms" (https://claude.ai/artifact/2erYxWz2ffDNcoXzEfu6wf), read 23 Oct 2026: page "1 List and row menus" ("A 31-character term name"). Compare the screen with the pictures below; the expected results above come from the PRD quotes, except where this held design case follows the design.

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • ct-p1-12-a-31-character-term-name.png

The design's own words:

  • “Rendered from the local build with "Net 45 Fleet Accounts Payable X" (31 characters, the longest allowed). At 1440px it fits on one line; on a narrower screen the name wraps and is never cut off (S1-R15).”
